programme.title: Sofia
programme.desc: Canary Islands are one of the best surfing spots in Europe. For surfing champion Sofia De Tomas, surf is just like art : she cannot live without it. And she really knows how to connect those two.

programme.title: Un día en...Salón Internacional Náutico de Barcelona
programme.desc: A day at...International Barcelona Boat Show.During the 4 days of the exhibition, you can discover more than 275 international exhibitors and almost 700 boats on the water, and many more boats at the show.

programme.title: Salon Nautique Paris
programme.desc: Among the world's greatest boat shows, Salon Nautique in Paris is back! Join Nico Peduzzi at the prestigious Port de Versailles and discover this year's hottest innovations in sailing, motorboats, board sports, equipment, tourism and more.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise
programme.desc: Embark on a breathtaking marine odyssey with Anchored in Paradise, a luxurious immersion amidst the sky, the sea, and the shores of the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Inside Superyachts
programme.desc: Arguably, a superyacht is the most glamorous holiday you can take. Burgess yachts, the largest yacht broker in the world, talks to us about the process of owning and/or chartering your very own yacht.We take a look at just how yachts are marketed and meet with Australian Shipbuilders Silver Yachts, who achieved the amazing feat of getting a Mercedes car onto their Yacht Silver Fast for one of the most epic yachts commercials ever.For those wanting more than a charter, but don’t want to own a boat outright, we introduce them to MAHA Yachts, a brand new concept bridging the gap between Charter and Sales – a unique collaboration with the world leading hotelier Adrian Zecha from Aman Hotels and Feadship.We sign off with one last adventure underwater, exploring the sea with Deep Flight and Rainbow Fish, interviewing Dr. Xin Wu who is helping to pioneer deep water tourism.

programme.title: MAR
programme.desc: Surfing has ceased a long time ago to be considered a niche sport. As the mainstream industry discovers its potential for selling clothes, trips and a whole set of ‘lifestyle’ products, there are those who appreciate it for what it is in its purest form – a direct connection to mother nature.We accompany Big Wave surfer Alex Botelho and some of his friends to meet surfers who balance their love for the ocean and nature with a professional career in the sport. Mar is a tale of discovery, triumph and (almost) tragedy, but above all it is a life affirming pledge to positive vibes in and out of the line-up.Get ready to soak up a new conception of the world of surf as Alex Botelho unveils concepts unknown for the mainstream audience, available on Nautical Channel.Awards:Best Feature Documentary – Best Istanbul Film Festival 2021. Official Selections 2021: Ocean Film Festival World Tour, International Ocean Film Festival.

programme.title: Tv7
programme.desc: Le false minacce diffuse via mail nelle scuole italiane ed europee aprono la puntata, con un'inchiesta sui meccanismi degli attacchi informatici e sulle indagini dell'antiterrorismo. Spazio poi al mercato delle recensioni online false, tra organizzazioni internazionali, richieste di denaro e testimonianze di professionisti e commercianti vittime di ricatti digitali. A diciannove anni dal ritrovamento di alcuni resti umani alla Magliana, un approfondimento torna sul mistero del cosiddetto collezionista di ossa, ripercorrendo le piste investigative e presentando una nuova ricostruzione del possibile volto di una delle vittime. Dall'estero, un reportage racconta il complesso scenario politico israeliano, tra i tentativi di formare un nuovo governo e il ruolo decisivo dei partiti arabi. Si torna in Italia con un'inchiesta sui furti di carte da collezione, un mercato sempre più redditizio finito nel mirino di bande criminali. Spazio anche alla musica e al teatro-canzone di Giorgio Gaber, attraverso le testimonianze di Brunori Sas, Paolo Jannacci e Lorenzo Luporini. Mauro Repetto, cofondatore degli 883, ripercorre invece la propria carriera, dal sodalizio con Max Pezzali alla nuova esperienza letteraria, tra memoria e riflessioni sull'intelligenza artificiale. Infine, dagli archivi del 1965, un servizio sulle abitudini degli italiani al ristorante, tra qualità del cibo, prezzi e curiosità di un'epoca.

programme.title: Buongiorno Benessere
programme.desc: Vira Carbone approfondisce i temi della salute e della prevenzione, a partire dal controllo del colesterolo e dalle proprietà nutrizionali dei formaggi. Spazio poi al primo soccorso in caso di tagli e ferite, alla calcolosi urinaria e ai disturbi della colonna vertebrale, dal dolore cervicale all'ernia del disco. Gli specialisti fanno inoltre il punto sui virus influenzali, sui metodi di cottura più salutari e sulle nuove tecniche di bypass coronarico. Infine, un approfondimento sui trattamenti estetici per il ringiovanimento del collo e del décolleté.

programme.title: Vista Terra
programme.desc: Nella prima puntata di Vista Terra. Un viaggio nell'Italia autentica, Federico Quaranta e Diletta Acanfora intraprendono un itinerario fatto di incontri, paesaggi e racconti. Un percorso per conoscere il territorio attraverso le persone che lo abitano, custodiscono le sue tradizioni e contribuiscono a costruirne il futuro. Dalla storia del fiume alle testimonianze del Battistero paleocristiano di Santa Maria Maggiore, fino alla devozione per la Madonna delle Galline e al ritmo della tammurriata: il racconto attraversa luoghi nei quali il patrimonio culturale continua a vivere nei gesti, nella musica e nella memoria delle comunità. Lo sguardo si apre poi al rapporto tra acqua e benessere, con un approfondimento sul termalismo insieme alla professoressa Annamaria Colao, e alle opportunità che nascono dall'incontro tra formazione, innovazione e sostenibilità. Tra i protagonisti del programma, il maestro Franco Pepe, che con la rubrica Pizze d'Italia porta sul piccolo schermo la sua arte e la sua sensibilità nel raccontare i territori attraverso il cibo. Nelle sue creazioni, la pizza diventa un incontro tra ricerca, memoria e saperi artigiani: ogni ingrediente custodisce infatti una storia, ogni sapore restituisce il legame con la terra e con il lavoro dei produttori.

programme.title: Linea Verde Storie
programme.desc: Conoscere davvero un territorio significa comprendere che cosa lo mantiene vivo, produttivo, riconoscibile. Linea Verde Storie parte da questa consapevolezza. Nella seconda puntata, Federico Quaranta e Giulia Capocchi sono in Emilia Romagna, nel cuore dell'Italia, e andando da Forlì a Bologna, seguono le tracce della antica via Emilia e della sua gente, ottimista per vocazione. Il loro cammino nasce dal desiderio di conoscere le persone ascoltando le loro storie, perché ogni casa, ogni paesaggio, ogni borgo racchiude un modo unico di vivere il territorio. Attraverso gli sguardi della gente incontrata, è possibile comprendere l'essenza più autentica di queste terre: una comunità che continua a rinnovarsi senza dimenticare le proprie radici. Dalle foreste alle colline, dai piccoli centri alle grandi città e alle vallate più remote, emerge un filo comune fatto di cura, protezione, tutela e fiducia nel futuro. È quel sentimento che Tonino Guerra, Romagnolo DOC seppe racchiudere in una frase semplice e luminosa: «L'ottimismo è il profumo della vita.» Un profumo che qui si respira nel vento tra gli alberi, nelle parole delle persone e nella capacità di queste terre di continuare a raccontarsi, stagione dopo stagione, alba dopo tramonto, ristoro dopo cammino.

programme.title: Linea Verde Italia
programme.desc: Monica Caradonna e Tinto si muovono dai Monti Lepini al Golfo di Gaeta, lungo strade antiche che da più di duemila anni mettono in comunicazione luoghi, persone e culture, in un itinerario tra i borghi che custodiscono la propria identità e guardano al futuro con innovazione, sostenibilità e nuove opportunità. I conduttori partono dall'antica Via Appia, Patrimonio Mondiale UNESCO, per raccontare le storie di chi sceglie di restare, di tornare e di investire nel proprio territorio. A Gaeta fanno conoscere al pubblico una sfida che nasce dall'inclusione e punta fino all'America's Cup, mentre sulle falesie della costa scoprono come sport e tutela della biodiversità possano convivere. A Bassiano, paese natale dello stampatore Aldo Manuzio, ascoltano una storia di solidarietà capace di trasformare le difficoltà in occasioni di crescita per i giovani, mentre a Sermoneta ascoltano invece la musica internazionale che risuona tra le mura del Castello Caetani, dove cultura e formazione continuano a parlare alle nuove generazioni. Entrano poi nel Parco Regionale Riviera di Ulisse, tra archeologia, ricerca e progetti di tutela ambientale, per scoprire come antichi mestieri e nuove tecnologie possano far nascere le professioni del futuro. Non mancano i sapori della tradizione, dalla celebre tiella di Gaeta a una ricetta che unisce i prodotti della terra e del mare, raccontando una storia di famiglia e di ricerca scientifica. Il viaggio si conclude alla Montagna Spaccata, uno dei luoghi più suggestivi del Lazio, dove si incontrano natura, storia e leggenda.

programme.title: Ciao Maschio
programme.desc: Gesti eclatanti e piccole rinunce quotidiane: fin dove si è disposti a spingersi per amore e quando la dedizione diventa follia? È il tema al centro della nuova puntata di Ciao Maschio. La trasmissione racconterà tutto ciò che gli uomini sono pronti a fare per amore, dai grandi gesti romantici alle follie più inconfessabili. Ospite l'attore, doppiatore e conduttore tv Pino Insegno. Tornerà, poi, una nuova donna del mistero, la cui identità verrà svelata nel corso della trasmissione. Non mancheranno gli amici di Ciao Maschio, Sergio Assisi, Francesco Arienzo ed Edoardo Tavassi. Con loro anche l'attore e regista Pino Quartullo, in scena a teatro in coppia con Maria Grazia Cucinotta con lo spettacolo La moglie fantasma. A sorpresa, anche il mentalista Leo Barbato. La parte musicale sarà, come sempre, affidata alle Swingeresse con Antonio Mezzancella, protagonisti di una rilettura di Parlami d'amore, successo dei Negramaro, e di un duetto con Pino Insegno sulle note di What a Wonderful World, fino al gran finale con This Love dei Maroon 5.

programme.title: Check Up
programme.desc: Luana Ravegnini approfondisce il tema dell'equilibrio glicemico e del diabete, a partire dai fattori di rischio, dai sintomi e dalla prevenzione del diabete di tipo 2. Spazio poi alle complicanze cardiovascolari, al diabete gestazionale e al ruolo dell'alimentazione nel controllo della glicemia, con particolare attenzione agli zuccheri aggiunti. Gli specialisti affrontano inoltre la salute dei reni e la gestione del diabete nella terza età. Infine, un approfondimento sulle terapie farmacologiche disponibili per il controllo della glicemia e la prevenzione delle complicanze.

programme.title: Linea Verde
programme.desc: Tappa nelle terre amatriciane, tra le province di Rieti e dell'Aquila, nella zona dei Monti della Laga, per Peppone Calabrese, Margherita Granbassi e Fabio Gallo: un viaggio nelle terre fragili colpite dal devastante terremoto del 2016, che per quanto abbia lasciato un segno profondo, non ha scalfito il carattere delle popolazioni che qui vivono da sempre. Peppone Calabrese si muove tra le tante frazioni del territorio, alla ricerca dei prodotti straordinari che rendono celebre la cucina locale e che compongono il piatto famoso in tutto il mondo: gli spaghetti alla amatriciana. Il guanciale arriva dalla lunghissima tradizione artigianale nella zona di montagna vicino a Campotosto e al suo meraviglioso lago, mentre la pasta è prodotta nell'unico e coraggioso pastificio amatriciano che ha saputo essere più tenace delle avversità causate dal sisma. Margherita Granbassi va alla scoperta dell'oasi di Orie Terme, a pochi chilometri da Amatrice, in cui la storica famiglia Betturri ha immaginato e realizzato un parco naturale nel vecchio castagneto per dare ospitalità a daini e cervi, facendo conoscere al pubblico il piccolo museo presso la frazione di Configno, in cui si custodisce la memoria della popolazione locale. Fabio Gallo racconta invece tre storie di tenacia e resilienza. Il viaggio si chiude sulle rive del lago di Scandarello, dove Peppone, Margherita e Fabio parlano dei risultati della ricerca della sapienza di questo territorio, concentrata nel suo piatto simbolo: la pasta all'amatriciana.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: In einer Hafenanlage ist die junge Cindy Opfer einer Haiattacke geworden. Da sich die Tiere aber gewöhnlich nicht in die Nähe von starkem Schiffsverkehr begeben, stellt sich die Frage, warum Cindy dort angegriffen wurde. Die Obduktion ergibt, dass die junge Frau zunächst angeschossen wurde und den Hai durch das ausströmende Blut anlockte. Cindy arbeitete als Treuetesterin für ein Detektivbüro. Viele Männer haben sie bedroht.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Einem jungen Paar fällt eine tote Frau vor die Füße, die offenbar von einem Parkhausdach gesprungen ist. Bei der Autopsie stellt sich heraus, dass die Frau schon vorher erstickt und anschließend vom Dach geworfen wurde. Über eine Uhr, die das Opfer trug, stößt man auf Thomas Chandler, den Käufer dieser Uhr. Von ihm erfahren Horatio und sein Team, dass es sich bei der Toten um die reiche Nikki Wilcox handelt, die riskante Unternehmungen liebte.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Ein Anästhesist an einer renommierten Beauty-Klinik wird erhängt in seinem Appartement aufgefunden. An seinem Hals entdeckt Alexx Würgemale, die beweisen, dass der Mediziner vor dem Aufhängen erwürgt wurde. Die Ermittlungen ergeben, dass vor kurzem die Patientin Sara Foster während einer Brustoperation starb. Deren Ehemann gerät unter Verdacht, als Horatio und sein Team feststellen, dass der Mann tatsächlich in der Wohnung des Toten war.

programme.title: CSI: Den Tätern auf der Spur
programme.desc: Ein mutmaßlicher Dealer wurde ermordet. Am Tatort entdeckt Greg in einem Abfallcontainer eine weitere Leiche. Bei dem Opfer handelt es sich um einen etwa fünfjährigen Jungen, der offenbar misshandelt wurde und verhungert ist. Sara kann das Kind als Devon Malton identifizieren, der zuletzt im Pflegeheim einer gewissen Mrs. Tenney registriert war. Doch dann erfährt Sara, dass Devon und seine beiden Brüder von seiner Mutter abgeholt wurden.

programme.title: CSI: Den Tätern auf der Spur
programme.desc: Denny Kingsley wird tot in seiner Wohnung aufgefunden. Er hatte sich als Sherlock Holmes verkleidet. Zunächst deutet alles auf Selbstmord hin, doch dann entdeckt Greg Blut auf den Schuhen von Kingsleys Freund Nelson Oakes. Das CSI-Team ermittelt in einem Kreis bizarrer Personen: Kingsley hatte sich regelmäßig mit einigen Gleichgesinnten getroffen, um die Fälle des Meisterdetektivs Sherlock Holmes zu diskutieren.

programme.title: CSI: Den Tätern auf der Spur
programme.desc: In einer Zeitungsbox findet man den Kopf einer Frau. Nachdem Catherine das Opfer als Veronica Juarez identifizieren konnte, führt eine Spur in einen mexikanischen Club. Dort erfahren die CSI-Ermittler, dass Veronica kurz vor ihrem Tod von einem Unbekannten bedroht wurde. Warrick und Brass untersuchen unterdessen den Mord an dem Vertreter Vincent DeCarlo, der erschossen am Steuer eines Vans gefunden wurde.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report - Einzeleinsätze

programme.title: Falling Like Snowflakes - Im Fokus der Liebe
programme.desc: Teagan Ainsley, Künstlerin und Lehrerin, möchte zu Weihnachten eine seltene Schneeflocke fotografieren, um ihre Serie zu vervollständigen und die Finanzierung einer neuen Heizungsanlage im Gemeindezentrum zu sichern. Noah Cooper, ihre Jugendliebe, begleitet sie widerwillig in die verschneiten Berge. Während eines Wintersturms entflammen alte Gefühle, und es geht nicht mehr nur um Wärme im Gemeindezentrum, sondern auch in ihren Herzen.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Christmases - Ein Weihnachten kommt selten allein
programme.desc: Emma steht vor der Entscheidung zwischen zwei unterschiedlichen Weihnachtsfeiern. In der Stadt verbringt sie die Feiertage mit einem neuen Schwarm, während sie zu Hause bei ihrer Familie und Drew ist. Diese Erlebnisse führen sie zu der Erkenntnis, was ihr im Leben und in der Liebe wirklich wichtig ist und sie glücklich macht.

programme.title: Unwrapping Christmas - Ein Weihnachtswunder für Tina
programme.desc: Tina, die erfolgreiche Inhaberin eines Geschenkeladens, steht vor der Herausforderung, die diesjährige Weihnachtsgala zu organisieren. Ihre Pläne geraten jedoch in Gefahr, als ein geiziger Gutsherr die Absage der Veranstaltung in Aussicht stellt. Trotz der Schwierigkeiten versucht Tina, die Gala zu retten und den festlichen Geist aufrechtzuerhalten.

programme.title: Unwrapping Christmas - Ein Weihnachtsprinz für Mia
programme.desc: Mia, die Liebesromane liebt, trifft auf Beau, einen Philanthropen, der das Ebenbild ihres Lieblingshelden aus einem Buch ist. Die beiden überlegen, ob sie eine neue Romanze beginnen sollen. Doch Beaus Mutter verfolgt andere Absichten.

programme.title: Falling Like Snowflakes - Im Fokus der Liebe
programme.desc: Teagan Ainsley, Künstlerin und Lehrerin, möchte zu Weihnachten eine seltene Schneeflocke fotografieren, um ihre Serie zu vervollständigen und die Finanzierung einer neuen Heizungsanlage im Gemeindezentrum zu sichern. Noah Cooper, ihre Jugendliebe, begleitet sie widerwillig in die verschneiten Berge. Während eines Wintersturms entflammen alte Gefühle, und es geht nicht mehr nur um Wärme im Gemeindezentrum, sondern auch in ihren Herzen.

programme.title: Winter Castle - Romanze im Eishotel
programme.desc: Jennys Schwester feiert ihre Hochzeit in einem wunderschönen Eishotel. Die Winterkulisse wird nicht nur zur Inspiration für eine neue Geschichte, mit der Jenny ihrem Traum als Kinderbuchautorin zu arbeiten, näherkommt. Der magische Ort wird ebenso zum Schauplatz für den Beginn ihrer eigenen Liebesgeschichte. Alles scheint perfekt zu sein, doch plötzlich taucht die unerwartete Begleitung von dem Mann auf, in den sie sich bereits verliebt hat.

programme.title: Geteilte Weihnacht
programme.desc: Emory ist Autorin eines Reisemagazins und reist gewöhnlich durch die ganze Welt. Deshalb beschließt sie, Weihnachten entspannt allein zu Hause zu verbringen. Ihre beste Freundin und Herausgeberin Veronica hat jedoch kurzfristig einen Auftrag für sie, der Emory nach Pine Grove bringt. Dort trifft sie unerwartet, auf den verwitweten Anwalt Scott, seine Mutter und seine Tochter Katy, die scheinbar die selbe Ferienhütte gebucht haben.

programme.title: Neue Geschichten vom Pumuckl
programme.desc: Die Kinder vom Vorderhaus feiern den Beginn der Sommerferien mit einer Wasserbombenschlacht. Doch als der spaßbefreite Nachbar Burke die Wasserbomben beschlagnahmt, fordern die Kinder Rache. Ein unsichtbarer Pumuckl unterstützt sie dabei. Kurz darauf ist Burkes Hund rasiert! Und Burke wurde mit Wasserbomben beworfen. Als sich die Polizei einschaltet, wird Eder zum Hauptverdächtigen. Wie soll Pumuckl das wieder hinbekommen?

programme.title: Exclusiv am Samstag
programme.desc: Wo ein roter Teppich ausgerollt wird, ist Exclusiv nicht weit. Auch am Wochenende liefert Deutschlands erfolgreichstes Starmagazin die aktuellsten Promi-News, verrät die heißesten Gerüchte und gibt Einblicke in das Leben der angesagtesten Celebrities dieser Welt. Darüber hinaus bietet Exclusiv am Samstag genügend Raum für ausführliche Reportagen und spannende Backstage-Geschichten.

programme.title: RTL Aktuell
programme.desc: Im Vordergrund der Hauptnachrichtensendung RTL Aktuell stehen die Themen, die wirklich relevant für die Zuschauer sind. Welche Auswirkungen haben politische Entscheidungen, wirtschaftliche Entwicklungen, soziale Trends und Innovationen wie zum Beispiel medizinische Neuerungen auf ihr Leben? Diese an den unmittelbaren Interessen der Zuschauer orientierten Fragen stehen konsequent im Mittelpunkt der Nachrichtenvermittlung bei RTL Aktuell.

programme.title: Life - Menschen, Momente, Geschichten
programme.desc: Life - Menschen, Momente, Geschichten ist das Magazin mit Annika Begiebing. Authentisch, glaubwürdig, modern. Life zeigt außergewöhnliche Menschen, die Herausragendes geleistet haben. Berichtet über Momente, die bewegen und begeistern. Life - Reporter liefern Hintergründe, decken auf, sind auf der ganzen Welt unterwegs. Sie finden Geschichten, die faszinieren, informieren und staunen lassen.

programme.title: Harry Potter und der Orden des Phönix
programme.desc: Kurz vor Ende der Sommerferien werden Harry und sein Cousin von Dementoren angegriffen. Im Zauberei-Ministerium glaubt man ihm nicht, dass Voldemort zurück ist. Es wird ein Verfahren wegen der ungenehmigten Nutzung von Magie gegen Harry eröffnet. Gerade als Harry befürchtet, dass er den Kampf gegen das Böse allein führen muss, erhält er Hilfe vom Orden des Phönix, der von Dumbledore gegründet wurde, um Voldemort und sein Gefolge zu bekämpfen.

programme.title: Blade 2
programme.desc: Kaum hat Blade seinen Freund Whistler aus den Fängen der Vampire befreit, muss er schon wieder ins Reich der Finsternis, weil er von den Vampiren um Hilfe gebeten wurde. Ihr Volk wird von den Reapers bedroht - Vampir-Mutanten, die die Herrschaft über die Welt an sich reißen wollen. Im Kampf gegen die blutsaugenden Horden um den Reaper Nomak wird Blade von Reinhardt unterstützt, dem Anführer der Bloodpacks, einer Elitetruppe der Vampire.

programme.title: Blade
programme.desc: Nacht für Nacht tobt in Los Angeles ein Krieg, in dessen Mittelpunkt ein unerschrockener Kämpfer steht: Blade! In der Nacht seiner Geburt wurde seine Mutter von Vampiren umgebracht. Blade ist halb Mensch, halb Vampir. Nun zieht er in eine blutige Schlacht, um seine Mutter zu rächen. Blades größter Feind ist Deacon Frost, ein junger Vampir, der die Menschheit vernichten will.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report
programme.desc: Als ein kleiner Junge mit seinem Hund verschwindet, beginnt für die Beamten eine fieberhafte Suche. Und: Auf der Sonnenblende ihres eben gekauften Gebrauchtwagens entdeckt eine Frau einen verzweifelten Hilferuf. Können die Beamten noch rechtzeitig helfen?

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report
programme.desc: Bei einer Verkehrskontrolle verschwindet eine Polizistin. Können die Beamten den zu allem entschlossenen Täter finden und ihre Kollegin retten? Und: Ein als Plüschschwein Verkleideter klaut ein Taxi samt Fahrgast. Die Beamten kommen schon bald einer echten Sauerei auf die Spur.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report
programme.desc: Die Rettung einer in einem See treibenden Frauenleiche entpuppt sich als äußerst gemeines Ablenkungsmanöver für eine ganz andere Straftat.Und: Auf einem Campingplatz eskaliert ein Streit zwischen einem Camper und zwei splitternackten Frauen. Kommen die Beamten der nackten Wahrheit auf die Spur?

programme.title: Winter Castle 2 - Eine winterliche Liebe
programme.desc: Die Hotelmanagerin Hannah arbeitet aufgrund eines beruflichen Fehlschlags in einem Reisebüro. Eigentlich ist sie Spezialistin für Tropengebiete, aber nun soll sie sich zu Recherchezwecken in den Norden Kanadas begeben, um sich das berühmt berüchtigte Eishotel anzuschauen. Der anfängliche Widerwille ist wie weggeblasen, als sie den Besitzer des Eishotels kennenlernt - Ben Wade. Doch sie ist nicht die einzige, die ein Auge auf ihn geworfen hat.

programme.title: RTL Spendenmarathon - Stars im Einsatz
programme.desc: Kurz vor dem 31. RTL-Spendenmarathon am 19/20. November zeigt Wolfram Kons in dieser bewegenden Reportage, für welche Kinderhilfsprojekte sich die Stars in diesem Jahr mit Herz und Tatkraft stark machen. Mit dabei sind u. a. Bruce Darnell, Jan Köppen, Sandra Maischberger und Isabell Werth. www.rtlspendenmarathon.de

programme.title: Detroit Lions - Die Stunde der NFL-Underdogs
programme.desc: DETROIT LIONS - Die Stunde der Underdogs erzählt die unglaubliche Geschichte eines NFL-Teams, welches ewig unterschätzt wurde. Heimgesucht von einem Fluch, gelten die Lions über Jahrzehnte hinweg als das Gespött der Liga. Erst unter der Führung von Sheila Ford Hamp und mit Superstar Amon-Ra St. Brown gelingt die nicht für möglich gehaltene Wende. In dieser Dokumentation durchleben Trainer, Spieler und Fans erneut diese Achterbahn der Gefühle.

programme.title: NFL: Detroit Lions - New England Patriots
programme.desc: Die NFL kommt nach Europa! In diesem Jahr finden insgesamt sechs NFL International Games in Europa statt: drei in London sowie jeweils ein Spiel in München, Madrid und erstmals auch in Paris. RTL überträgt alle Spiele der internationalen Serie und bietet mit den Europa-Partien absolute Festtage für alle Football-Fans. Im Mittelpunkt steht das Munich Game im November - das Deutschlandspiel der NFL und für viele Fans der deutsche Super Bowl.

programme.title: RTL Aktuell
programme.desc: Im Vordergrund der Hauptnachrichtensendung RTL Aktuell stehen die Themen, die wirklich relevant für die Zuschauer sind. Welche Auswirkungen haben politische Entscheidungen, wirtschaftliche Entwicklungen, soziale Trends und Innovationen wie zum Beispiel medizinische Neuerungen auf ihr Leben? Diese an den unmittelbaren Interessen der Zuschauer orientierten Fragen stehen konsequent im Mittelpunkt der Nachrichtenvermittlung bei RTL Aktuell.

programme.title: NFL: Atlanta Falcons - Kansas City Chiefs
programme.desc: Das Herz der NFL schlägt bei RTL und NITRO. Jeden Sonntag steht die Primetime mit mindestens zwei Live-Spielen der Regular Season ganz im Zeichen von American Football. Inklusive aller Night Games können Fans die komplette NFL Game Week live bei RTL erleben. Jeweils zwischen September und Februar dürfen sich Fans auf über 200 Live-Übertragungen freuen. Mit Expertise und Leidenschaft präsentiert das On-Air-Team die größte Sportliga der Welt.

programme.title: NFL: Dallas Cowboys - San Francisco 49ers
programme.desc: Das Herz der NFL schlägt bei RTL und NITRO. Jeden Sonntag steht die Primetime mit mindestens zwei Live-Spielen der Regular Season ganz im Zeichen von American Football. Inklusive aller Night Games können Fans die komplette NFL Game Week live bei RTL erleben. Jeweils zwischen September und Februar dürfen sich Fans auf über 200 Live-Übertragungen freuen. Mit Expertise und Leidenschaft präsentiert das On-Air-Team die größte Sportliga der Welt.

programme.title: NFL: Cincinnati Bengals - Pittsburgh Steelers
programme.desc: Die NFL liefert mit Sunday Night Football Woche für Woche ein echtes Highlight unter Flutlicht. RTL und Sky Sport sind das Zuhause der NFL in Deutschland und bringen die Night Games direkt zu den Fans. Hier treffen ambitionierte Teams aufeinander. Es geht um wichtige Siege und starke Auftritte auf großer Bühne. Die Ansetzungen bieten regelmäßig intensive und packende Begegnungen, in denen jeder Spielzug den Unterschied machen kann.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report - Einzeleinsätze
programme.desc: Ob Raubüberfall, Brandstiftung oder hilflose Personen - die Arbeit von Polizisten, Notärzten und Rettungssanitätern erfordert nicht nur Sachkenntnis, sondern auch Einfühlungsvermögen und Durchsetzungskraft. Häufig sind sie gemeinsam vor Ort, wenn rund um einen Polizeieinsatz medizinische Erstversorgung gefragt ist. Der Blaulicht Report erzählt Geschichten aus dem aufregenden Berufsalltag dieser Retter in Not.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report - Einzeleinsätze
programme.desc: Ob Raubüberfall, Brandstiftung oder hilflose Personen - die Arbeit von Polizisten, Notärzten und Rettungssanitätern erfordert nicht nur Sachkenntnis, sondern auch Einfühlungsvermögen und Durchsetzungskraft. Der Blaulicht Report erzählt Geschichten aus dem aufregenden Berufsalltag dieser Retter in Not.

programme.title: Bekas (16)
programme.desc: Draama Irakin kurdialueelta 90-luvun alusta. Kaksi koditonta poikaa näkee Teräsmiehen ja päättää lähteä USA:han.

programme.title: Underbara älskade (7)
programme.desc: Lars menetti vaimonsa ja nuorimman poikansa auto-onnettomuudessa yhdeksän kuukautta sitten. Nyt Lars ja hänen toinen poikansa Jonas tuskin puhuvat toisilleen. Lars toivoo pääsevänsä eroon tuhoisasta apatiastaan lähtemällä Jonasin kanssa perheen kesähuvilalle saaristoon.

programme.title: Elämäni koirana (7)
programme.desc: Ingemar asuu veljensä ja sairaan äitinsä kanssa. Hänellä on vaikeaa, mutta ei niin vaikeaa kuin Laika-koiralla avaruudessa. Ingemar lähetetään kesäksi maalle isoäitinsä luokse. Siellä hän tapaa ihmisiä, jotta muuttavat hänen elämäänsä.

programme.title: Bert - viimeinen viaton (S)
programme.desc: Bertiä koetellaan. Hän on juuri aloittanut yhdeksännen luokan ja ajattelee tyttöjä koko ajan. Kaikki paitsi hän seurustelevat jo ja ovat tehneet SITÄ satoja kertoja. Ainoa mahdollisuus päästä eroon viimeisen neitsyen taakasta on Victoria - ihana pikku olento, joka ilmaantuu Bertin kotipaikkakunnalle Öreskogaan aivan pääkaupungista saakka. Mutta Victoria ihastuu blondiin kiiltokuvapoika Carl-Philipiin, jolla on pitkä, hulmuava tukka...

programme.title: Astrid Lindgrens jul
programme.desc: Joulujaksoja kahdeksasta Astrid Lindgrenin rakastettuihin kertomuksiin perustuvasta elokuvasta, Pepistä ja Eemelistä Marikkiin ja Saariston lapsiin.

programme.title: Hata Göteborg
programme.desc: Ryhmä teini-ikäisiä poikia huomaa ystävyytensä kärsivän, kun taisteluista tulee jalkapalloa tärkeämpänä. Yhden jengiläisen hippimäinen serkku saapuu Göteborgista ja näyttää kaikille uuden tavan suhtautua elämään.

programme.title: Populäärimusiikkia Vittulajänkältä (16)
programme.desc: Reza Bagherin filmatisointi Mikael Niemen kirjasta, joka on villi kasvukertomus, jossa Niila ja Matti oppivat tuntemaan rock'n'rollia ja omaa seksuaalisuuttaan juominkien ja saunomisen välissä 1960-luvun Pajalassa.

programme.title: Saariston lapset ja hylje (7)
programme.desc: Saltkråkanilla on kesä ja Pampula on ikionnellinen saadessaan Vestermanilta hylkeenpoikasen. Hylkeen nimeksi tulee Mooses ja kaikki saariston asukkaat pitävät siitä. Vesterman haluaa hylkeen takaisin saatuaan tietää, että voisi myydä sen hyvällä hinnalla, mutta siihen Pampula ei aio suostua vaan yhdessä Pellen ja Stinan kanssa hän piilottaa Mooseksen.

programme.title: Avaruudessa ei ole tunteita (7)
programme.desc: Draamakomedia Simonista, jolla on Aspergerin oireyhtymä, mikä mutkistaa kaikkea hänen yrittäessään hankkia tyttöystävää masentuneelle veljelleen.

programme.title: Polta nämä kirjeet (12)
programme.desc: Tosipohjaiseen kirjaan perustuva ruotsalaisdraama 1930-luvulla eletystä intohimoisesta kolmiodraamasta, jonka jälkikaiut ulottuvat nykypäivään saakka.

programme.title: Seuramatka (S)
programme.desc: Kanarian saarilla on joulun aikaan sikajuhlat, ja siellä Stig Helmer Olsson on ensimmäisellä ulkomaanmatkallaan. Hän ei tiedä että tohtori Levander, joka on hoitanut hänen lentopelkoaan, on huijannut häntä tuomaan saarille pimeästi rahaa.

programme.title: Kalle mestarietsivä (7)
programme.desc: Lillköpingin kesäidyllissä on rauhallista. Moni kakku päältä kaunis: käynnissä on sota Punaisen ja Valkoisen Ruusun välillä. Taistelun kohteena on Stormumriken, mikä ulkopuolisten silmin näyttää aivan tavalliselta kiveltä. Yhtäkkiä ukko Gren löydetään kuolleena. Nyt tarvitaan Kalle mestarietsivää!

programme.title: Lasinpuhaltajan lapset (S)
programme.desc: Joen toisella puolella suuressa linnassa asuu Valtiatar Valtiattarensa kanssa. Valtiaan suurin ilo on, kun hän saa totella Valtiatarta. Eräänä päivänä hän toivoo että hänellä olisi lapsia, pieni poika ja pieni tyttö...

programme.title: Iso paksu isäni (S)
programme.desc: Rolf Lassgårdin Guldbagge-palkittu draama sijoittuu kesään 1959. Ruotsin pölyisillä teillä liikkuu Volvo PV kyydissään 11-vuotias Osvald ja tämän vanhemmat. Isällä on tapansa mukaan suuria suunnitelmia; hän aikoo opettaa kirkkokuorolle uuden messun, pelata jalkapalloa poikansa kanssa ja parantaa kuntoaan juoksemalla traktorin perässä.

programme.title: Hypnotisoija (16)
programme.desc: Synkkänä joulukuisena yönä psykiatri Erik Maria Bark herää, kun hänelle soitetaan tukholmalaisesta sairaalasta. Rikosetsivä Joona Linna pyytää häntä auttamaan akuutista traumasta kärsivän tajuttoman potilaan hoitamisessa.

programme.title: Ystävät hämärän jälkeen (16)
programme.desc: Oskar unelmoi kostosta, sillä kiusatun 12-vuotiaan elämä ei ole ruusuilla tanssimista. Oskarin elämä kuitenkin muuttuu, kun hän tapaa Elin, omalaatuisen tytön, joka ei syö eikä siedä aurinkoa. Vähitellen Oskarille selviää, että Eli on vampyyri, jonka on juotava toisten verta selviytyäkseen. Oskarin on päätettävä mitä hän on valmis hyväksymään...

programme.title: Medicinen (7)
programme.desc: Tässä Colin Nutleyn komediassa Johannasta tulee koehenkilö, jolla testataan uutta lääkettä. Lääkkeellä on odottamattomia sivuvaikutuksia.

programme.title: Tuppen (7)
programme.desc: Vuosi 1944. Miehet ovat sotilaina, ympäri maata unelmoidaan rauhasta ja aidosta kahvista. Örnen i Ryd -tekstiilitehtaassa elämä kulkee omalla painollaan. Yhtäkkiä uusi insinööri Cederquist ilmestyy paikalle, ja tehdas on täynnä tyttöjä...

programme.title: Miss Sweden (12)
programme.desc: 19-vuotias Moa (Alexandra Dahlström) elää tekee kaikkensa sulautuakseen joukkoon, mutta huomaakin olevansa kiinnostunut vääristä tyypeistä, kuuntelevansa vääränlaista musiikkia ja tekevänsä vääriä valintoja. Kun kaveritkin tuntuvat pitävän häntä vain pilkan kohteena, Moa saa tarpeekseen. Ohjaus: Tova Magnusson-Norling. Käsikirjoitus: Sara Kadefors.

programme.title: Elämä on i-ha-haa (S)
programme.desc: Yksinhuoltajaisä Fredrik haluaa menestyä ravikuskina, mutta hänellä on vaikeuksia saada elämänsä palaset kohdallaan. Kaikki muuttuu, kun hän tapaa Helenan. Hän tajuaa mikä elämässä on tärkeää ja keksii lopuksi voittoisan menetelmän.

programme.title: Onnen kukkuloilla (7)
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen romanttinen komedia eri-ikäisistä ihmisistä, joiden elämät punoutuvat yhteen sattumien ja rakkaudenkaipuun ansiosta.

programme.title: Loranga, Masarin ja Dartanjang (7)
programme.desc: Loranga on maailman paras isä. Vaikka hän on aikuinen, hän rakastaa poppia eikä halua mennä töihin, koska leikkii poikansa Masarinin kanssa. Dartanjang asuu vajassa, koska pelkää bakteereita. Hän on siitä huolimatta jatkuvasti kipeänä.

programme.title: Saariston lapset (S)
programme.desc: Saariston asukkaat saavat kuulla että Malin ja Peter ovat saaneet ensimmäisen lapsensa! Melker on niin epäkäytännöllinen isoisä, että hänen on melkein mahdotonta pitää silmällä pikkuista.

programme.title: Veljeni Leijonamieli
programme.desc: Veljekset Korppu ja Joonatan Leijona tapaavat jälleen lyhyeksi jääneen maanpäällisen elämänsä jälkeen maassa nimeltä Nangijala, jossa vallitsee tarun ja nuotiotulten aikakausi.

programme.title: Cornelis (7)
programme.desc: Cornelis on elokuva yhdestä Ruotsin suurimmista musiikkilegendoista - Cornelis Vreeswijkistä. Elokuva on rehellinen kuvaus taiteilijasta, jonka laajaan tuotantoon katsoja päästetään lähelle.

programme.title: Seuramatkat 2 - hassunhauska hiihtoloma (S)
programme.desc: Silmät auki rinteessä! Stig Helmer on taas matkalla, ja tällä kertaa kyseessä on todellinen ulkoilmaelämys!

programme.title: Ryöstetty Rasmus ja Kalle Mestarietsivä
programme.desc: Lillköpingissä Punaisen ja Valkoisen Ruusun välinen taistelu jatkuu. Eräänä yönä Valkoinen Ruusu todistaa, kuinka Professori ja hänen pieni poikansa Rasmus kidnapataan. Onneksi Kalle mestarietsivä on paikalla!

programme.title: The Queen of Sheba's Pearls (7)
programme.desc: Colin Nutleyn draama salaperäisestä naisesta, joka odottamatta ilmestyy erään perheen luo Englannin maaseudulla.

programme.title: Henkivartijat (16)
programme.desc: Johan Falkin ystävällä Sven Petterssonilla on vaatefirma, joka toimii osittain ulkomailla. Suojautuakseen Viron mafialta hän turvautuu saksalaiseen turvallisuuseksperttiin. Tämä on kuitenkin gangsteri, ja pian Sven on pulassa.

programme.title: Lain nimessä (16)
programme.desc: Neljän poliisin ryhmä kiertelee Tukholman kaduilla hakkaamassa juoppoja ja rikollisia. Kun ryhmän pidättämä alkoholisti löytyy putkasta kuolleena, rikostarkastaja Jarnebring alkaa tutkia heidän toimiaan tarkemmin. Samalla tutkittavaksi joutuu kaupungin ravintolakuningas Danucci, jota epäillään laajasta huumekaupasta.

programme.title: 438 dagar (16)
programme.desc: Toimittajat Martin Schibbye ja Johan Persson pistävät kaiken peliin ylittäessään Somalian ja Etiopian välisen rajan. Heidän tarkoituksenaan on tutkia kuinka öljyn etsintä vaikuttaa paikallisväestöön.

programme.title: Britt-Marie kävi täällä (S)
programme.desc: Kun 63-vuotias kaavoihin kangistunut Britt-Marie jättää miehensä 40 avioliittovuoden jälkeen, hän joutuu kohtaamaan muuttuneen maailman. Hän päätyy ankeaan Borgin syrjäkylään, jossa elämä tuntuu junnaavan paikoillaan niillä harvoilla, jotka kylää vielä asuttavat. Siellä piilee kuitenkin suuria unelmia, jotka herättävät Britt-Marien syvälle haudatun uskon tulevaan. Ehkä elämä antaa uuden mahdollisuuden. Ehkä koskaan ei ole liian myöhäistä alkaa elää.

programme.title: Sean Banan inuti Seanfrika
programme.desc: Sean Banan lähtee Afrikkaan kuvaamaan musiikkivideota. Kaoottinen matka sisältää venejahteja, villieläimiä ja omituisia kohtaamisia.

programme.title: Uutisreportteri Morgan Pålsson (12)
programme.desc: Epäpätevä ruotsalaistoimittaja valokuvaajineen joutuu ainoana ulkomaalaistiiminä keskelle sotilasvallankaappausta pienessä afrikkalaisessa maassa.

programme.desc: Kymppitonnin erikoisjaksossa kilpailemassa Arttu Wiskari And friends, jotka ovat Sami Hintsanen, Antti Ketonen, Susanna Ruotsalainen ja Hanna Kinnunen. Naljailua riittää, kun kaverukset kilpailevat paikasta finaaliin. Peliä viheltämässä poikki Cristal Snow.

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Elokuvafestivaalin vieraat työllistävät Sodankylän partioita kahdessa vuorossa. Rantanen ja Numminen maistelevat eksoottisia ruokia ja selvittävät ennestään tutun pariskunnan välejä. Vaarla ja Pikkukangas kuuntelevat parguyalaisia rytmejä ja selvittelevät pahoinpitelyä.

programme.title: Lapin poliisit
programme.desc: Inarijärvellä vanhemmat konstaapelit Valle ja Autti valvovat juhannuksen vesiliikennettä. Ylikonstaapeli Jänkälä ja vanhempi konstaapeli Katajamäki valvovat juhannuksen viettoa Rovaniemellä sekä Ranualla.

programme.title: Kymppitonni
programme.desc: Kuka on illan Hannu Hanhi? Kymppitonnissa kilpailemassa Aku Ankka -lehden päätoimittaja Aki Hyyppä, toimittaja Roman Schatz, yrittäjä Satu Aarnio sekä muusikot Antti Koivula ja Pauliina Kokkonen.

programme.title: Speranza Scappucci, Philharmonia Zürich, Chorus Of The Opernhaus, Zürich And Irina Lungu - Donizetti - Lucia di Lammermoor
programme.desc: Italian conductor Speranza Scappucci leads the Philharmonia Zürich and the Chorus of the Opernhaus Zürich in a performance of Gaetano Donizetti’s tragic opera ‘Lucia di Lammermoor’ (1835). Salvatore Cammarano based his libretto on Sir Walter Scott’s novel ‘The Bride of Lammermoor’ (1819). Set in 17th century Scotland, the opera tells the story of Lucia, who falls in love with Edgardo, her family’s arch enemy. Lucia’s brother Enrico, however, forces her to marry a man she does not love instead, driving the young woman insane. Highpoint of the opera is Lucia’s famous ‘mad scene’, in which the technically demanding aria ‘Il dolce suono’ is heard. In this scene, Lucia’s voice is accompanied by a glass harmonica, adding to its eeriness. Italian conductor Speranza Scappucci leads the Philharmonia Zürich and the Chorus of the Opernhaus Zürich. Among the soloists are Irina Lungu (Lucia), Massimo Cavalletti (Enrico Ashton), Piotr Beczała (Edgardo di Ravenswood), Andrew Owens (Lord Arturo Bucklaw), Oleg Tsibulko (Raimondo Bidebent), Roswitha Christina Müller (Alisa), and Iain Milne (Normanno). This performance was recorded at the Opernhaus Zürich, Switzerland, in 2021.

programme.title: Olivier Latry, Emmanuel Curt, Shin-Young Lee And Damien Petitjean - Le Grand Orgue in Concert
programme.desc: Current holder of “Great Organ of the Notre Dame,” Olivier Latry began his musical career when he enrolled in Gaston Litaize’s organ class at the Academy of Saint-Maur at the age of 16. In 1985, at 23 years of age, Latry was awarded the post of one of four “titulaires des grands orgues” of Notre Dame, Paris. Besides enriching the musical world as an organist, improvisor and composer, Olivier Latry also works as a Professor of Organ at the Conservatoire de Paris. This performance of his, showcasing pieces of Bach, Vierne and Daquin, was recorded in 2015, at Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris.

programme.title: Hans van Manen, Dutch National Ballet And Sjeng Scheijen - Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Renowned Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen reflects on his life, artistic vision, and celebrated career. Friends and colleagues share insights alongside excerpts from his groundbreaking ballets.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra And Michael Tilson Thomas - Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: Conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in an energetic performance of Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2, Little Russian, recorded at LSO St Luke's in London.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwarz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece’s title refers to humor as an emotional state. Schumann took his inspiration from German Romantic writer Jean Paul, who defines humor as “an infinity of contrast”, “a setting of the small world beside the great”, and where “a kind of laughter results which contains pain and greatness”. Humoreske is one continuous piece consisting of contrasting sections. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.

programme.title: Julie Berthollet - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Andrea Bacchetti - Bach - Preludes and Fugues And Alla variata BWV 989
programme.desc: Pianist Andrea Bacchetti performs keyboard works by J. S. Bach, featuring selections from The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book II, and the Aria variata alla maniera italiana in A minor, recorded live at Teatro Sociale di Camogli in Italy.

programme.title: Martha Argerich, Mischa Maisky And Annie Dutoit - Works for cello and piano by Schumann, Chopin a.o.
programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music. Between the pieces, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit in an intimate interview that addresses both their relationship and the music. This broadcast was recorded on November 12 and 13, 2020, in Geneva, Switzerland.

programme.title: András Schiff And Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet de la Escuela Superior de Música Reina Sofía - Bach Concerto And Mendelssohn Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: The legendary Sir András Schiff takes on the dual role of conductor and soloist in this special concert with the Freixenet Symphony Orchestra of the Reina Sofía School of Music. The program opens with Johann Sebastian Bach’s Keyboard Concerto No. 5 in F minor, BWV 1056, with Schiff himself at the piano. The concert concludes with Felix Mendelssohn’s magnificent ‘Italian’ Symphony No. 4.

programme.title: Olivier Latry - In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally. He sees himself as an ambassador of French music from the 17th through the 20th centuries as well as an advocate for the art of improvisation. Pieces played in the film are: Pierre Cochereau’s Boléro, Louis Vierne’s Carillon of Westminster and Scherzo from Symphony No. 2, Alexandre Guilmant’s Sonata No. 1, Charles-Marie Widor’s Gothic Symphony, Marcel Dupre’s Cortège, Litanie and J. S. Bach’s Passacaille And Fugue.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky - Ravel - La Valse
programme.desc: The exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a performance of Maurice Ravel’s La Valse, in an arrangement for two pianos. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: philharmonie zuidnederland And Hartmut Haenchen - Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7. The German-born conductor, who became a Dutch citizen through naturalisation, was chief conductor at the Dutch National Opera, the Netherlands Philharmonic Orchestra, and the Netherlands Chamber Orchestra before he was finally knighted for his services to the Dutch music landscape. The majestic opening theme of the first movement of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7 foreshadows a momentous work, lasting over 20 minutes. The doubt and turmoil felt throughout the Adagio, the second movement, are supposedly Bruckner's response to the news of the death of his idol, Richard Wagner. Bruckner's use of Wagner tubas and double bass tubas creates an even more solemn and grandiose air within the Adagio. Trumpet signals refer to crowing cockerels as they interrupt the grim and clamorous Scherzo. In the Finale, Bruckner employs a persistent rhythmic pulse that starts softly yet builds up towards the explosive final bars.

programme.title: Kristine Opolais, Latvian National Symphony Orchestra And Sesto Quatrini - Kristine Opolais Recital
programme.desc: Critics praise her, and the audience loves her. Kristine Opolais, the prima donna and the star of the New York Metropolitan Opera, performs in her home country Latvia. She gives a splendid concert with the Latvian National Symphony Orchestra, at the Latvian National Opera, in 2017. The program includes arias from operas that made Kristine an international star. It includes mostly Italian music that will encourage you to dream about love and think about what is truly important. Enjoy the most beautiful arias and instrumental pieces of opera by Giuseppe Verdi, Giacomo Puccini, Pietro Mascagni, Camille Saint-Saëns, Arrigo Boito, and Alfredo Catalani.

programme.title: Tim Weiss - Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway. Glass’s work, originally a choral piece for the Australian Dance Theatre, was only ever performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Over thirty years later, in 2019, Beacon Isle Films recorded a symphonic arrangement of Glass’s work, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss with soprano Berit Norbakken Solset as the soloist. Their recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten’s spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe’s story. Moreover, this inspiring documentary features a rare interview with Glass.

programme.title: Daniel Harding - Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor Op. 81
programme.desc: Manfred Honeck conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Brahms' Tragic Ouverture, Op. 81 during the Easter Concert in Baden-Baden 2016.

programme.title: Trio Arabica, Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, Tafelmusik Chamber Choir And Maryem Toller - Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. Its musical director is Jeanne Lamon. Together with the Trio Arabica they celebrate the music and culture in the eighteenth century. The cities of Leipzig and Damascus both lay at the crossroads of ancient trading routes and are important centres of scholarship and famous for their coffee houses, where music was performed by the most brilliant musicians of the day. This concert presents works by Bach, Telemann, Handel and treasures of classical Arabic music. In this cross-cultural café, music, words, and images are used to explore the ways in which people separated by great distances are bound together by trade, ideas, and art. Recorded at the Aga Khan Museum in Toronto. Created by Alison Mackay and staging by Marshall Pynkoski.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 4 in G major, BWV 1049. This concerto features solos from two recorders and a violin. The recorders play a prominent role in the concerto’s second movement, while the violin dominates the fast first and third movements.

programme.title: Mexico City Ballet - Recursivo
programme.desc: The Mexico City Ballet is a contemporary ballet company of international dancers based in Mexico City. International guest dancers help celebrate its anniversary gala, featuring works by resident choreographer Yazmín Barragán.

programme.title: Naoya Nishimura And Andrea Bacchetti - Works for violin and piano by Corelli, Ravel a.o.
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform an intimate recital recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan. On the program are Arcangelo Corelli’s Violin Sonata in D minor, Op. 5 No. 12, “La Folia”; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op. 24, “Spring”; Manuel de Falla’s 7 Canciones populares españolas; Maurice Ravel’s Sonata for violin and piano; Camille Saint-Saëns’ Introduction and Rondo Capriccioso in A minor, Op. 28; Niccolò Paganini’s Cantabile in D major, Op. 17; and Antonio Bazzini’s Scherzo fantastique, Op. 25, “La Ronde des Lutins”. This performance was recorded on June 22, 2019.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen And Pascal Amoyel - Grieg's Piano Concerto And Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Flanders Symphony Orchestra, Jan Latham-Koenig (director)Pascal Amoyel , pianoFelix Mendelssohn (1809 - 1847)Overture Die HebridenEdvard Grieg (1843 - 1907)Piano concerto in A minor opus 16Ludwig van Beethoven (1770 - 1827)Symphonie no 7Recorded on April, the 21st 2016 at the Concertgebouw, Bruges

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: Celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz performs Robert Schumann's Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13, a virtuosic work composed between 1834 and 1837 that began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 5 in D major, BWV 1050. Remarkably, the harpsichord appears as a solo instrument here, along with the flute and violin, rather than as an accompanying instrument. The piece is therefore considered one of Bach’s very first keyboard concertos.

programme.title: Irene Veneziano - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan And Cleveland Orchestra - Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No. 44 in E-minor, Vivier´s Lonely Child', Ligeti´s 'Lontano' and Death and Transfiguration by Richard Strauss.

programme.title: Tim Weiss - Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway. Glass’s work, originally a choral piece for the Australian Dance Theatre, was only ever performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Over thirty years later, in 2019, Beacon Isle Films recorded a symphonic arrangement of Glass’s work, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss with soprano Berit Norbakken Solset as the soloist. Their recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten’s spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe’s story. Moreover, this inspiring documentary features a rare interview with Glass.

programme.title: Daniel Harding, Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, Coro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino And Christiane Karg - Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna. At the time, Mozart was busy working on his operas La clemenza di Tito and The Magic Flute. By the time he started on the Requiem, in the fall of that same year, his health was seriously declining. Mozart passed away in December 1791, leaving the Requiem uncompleted. His pupil Franz Xaver Süssmayr completed Mozart’s swan song in the form known today, based on Mozart’s sketches and possibly verbal instructions. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Tero Saarinen - Hunt (The Rite of Spring)
programme.desc: Tero Saarinen’s signature solo HUNT is one of the most celebrated contemporary interpretations of Stravinsky’s The Rite of Spring, praised by audiences and critics alike. An exciting new screen version based on Saarinen’s final performances of the work offers one more chance to experience this ground-breaking work on television. Commissioned by the Venice Biennale in 2002, HUNT is a collaboration of choreographer-dancer Tero Saarinen and multimedia artist Marita Liulia. Saarinen toured with the work until the Rite's centennial in 2013. Finland's national public service broadcasting company YLE recorded the choreographer's last performances in his home city, Helsinki, at the main stage of the Finnish National Theatre in May 2013. Featuring material shot on stage and in the YLE studios, this exciting new screen version of HUNT gives audiences the possibility to experience this ground-breaking work once more - and for the first time ever on the silver screen.

programme.title: Olivier Latry - In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally. He sees himself as an ambassador of French music from the 17th through the 20th centuries as well as an advocate for the art of improvisation. Pieces played in the film are: Pierre Cochereau’s Boléro, Louis Vierne’s Carillon of Westminster and Scherzo from Symphony No. 2, Alexandre Guilmant’s Sonata No. 1, Charles-Marie Widor’s Gothic Symphony, Marcel Dupre’s Cortège, Litanie and J. S. Bach’s Passacaille And Fugue.

programme.title: De Nationale Opera, Nederlands Philharmonisch Orkest, Hartmut Haenchen And Thomas Johannes Mayer - Wagner - Das Rheingold
programme.desc: Hartmut Haenchen conducts the Netherlands Philharmonic Orchestra and Dutch National Opera in a production of Richard Wagner's opera Das Rheingold, the first opera of the four-part cycle 'Der Ring des Nibelungen'. Richard Wagner, perhaps the greatest innovator of the opera genre in the nineteenth century, aimed for the creation of a ‘Gesamtkunstwerk’ in which theatre, music and words are united. The opera cycle was composed between 1853 and 1874, and consists of Das Rheingold, Die Walküre, Siegfried, and Götterdämmerung. Noteworthy about Wagner's operas is his use of the so-called ‘Leitmotiv’, a recurrent melodic motif that stands for a certain idea or character. Moreover, Wagner uses unconventional harmonies and very extensive orchestral instrumentation. The entire cycle is still performed annually at the Bayreuth Festival, where it premiered in 1876. This 2014 performance was recorded at Het Muziektheater Amsterdam under the artistic direction of Pierre Audi. Among the soloists are Thomas Johannes Mayer, Vladimir Baykov, Marcel Reijans, Stefan Margita, and Werner van Mechelen.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sinfonia Rotterdam, Conrad van Alphen And Alvaro Siviero - Grieg - Piano Concerto, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, recorded in De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2018. Alvaro Siviero is the soloist in Grieg's Piano Concerto No. 1, and closes his performance with 'Dansa do Índio Branco' by Villa-Lobos. Grieg's Piano Concerto, Op. 16, composed in 1868, was the only concerto the composer completed. It is one of his most popular works and is among the most popular of all piano concertos. It is the composer’s earliest important work, written in Søllerød, Denmark, at the age of 24 years old.

programme.title: Matthias Goerne, Vilde Frang, Nicolas Altstaedt And Stathis Karapanos - J. S. Bach - Arias, solos, and duets
programme.desc: Baritone Matthias Goerne teams up with violinist Vilde Frang, cellist Nicolas Altstaedt, flutist Stathis Karapanos, and harpsichordist Michaela Hasselt in this program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. They perform baritone arias from Bach’s most beautiful cantatas, as well as solo pieces and duets. On the program are Sonata No. 3 in C major for violin solo, BWV 1005; arias ‘Hier, in meines Vaters Stätte’, BWV 32 and ‘Die Welt mit allen Königreichen’, BWV 59; Suite No. 5 in C minor for cello solo, BWV 1011; ‘Wenn Trost und Hülf ermangeln muß’, BWV 117; ‘Ja, ja, ich halte Jesum fest’, BWV 157; Invention No. 7 in E minor, BWV 778; Invention in A major, BWV 783; and ‘Welt ade, ich bin dein müde’, BWV 158. This performance was recorded at St. Mary’s Church in Wittenberg, Germany.

programme.title: Daniel Rowland, Rachel Roberts, Julian Arp And Diana Ketler - Strauss - Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Violinist Daniel Rowland, violist Rachel Roberts, cellist Julian Arp, and pianist Diana Ketler perform Richard Strauss’s Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13, as part of the Stiftfestival 2016 in the Dutch village of Weerselo. In his early years, Strauss tried to compose different types of chamber music works, including a piano quartet. The young composer started writing the Piano Quartet in C minor in the spring of 1884 and completed it one year later. The work is in four movements and shows considerable influence from Johannes Brahms. It premiered on December 8, 1885 in Weimar and was performed by members of the Halír Quartet with Strauss himself playing the piano part. The following year the work won the first prize given by the Berliner Tonkünstlerverein for a piano quartet. This performance was recorded at the Stiftkerk in Weerselo, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Zubin Mehta And Israel Philharmonic Orchestra - In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Conductor Zubin Mehta leads the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra in rehearsals for Richard Strauss's tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, capturing their collaborative musical dialogue.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig - Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically. The Norwegian premiere followed a few months later. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón And Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez dirigiert das Orchester und den Chor der Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in einer Aufführung der Carmina Burana von Carl Orff. Die Solisten der Performance sind Anabel de la Mora (Sopran), Andrés Carrillo (Tenor) und Cerón (Bariton). Carmina Burana ist eine in den Jahren 1935 und 1936 von Carl Orff komponierte Kantate, die auf 24 Gedichten aus der mittelalterlichen Sammlung Carmina Burana basiert. Der vollständige Titel lautet Lieder von Beuern: Weltliche Lieder für Sänger und Chöre zum gemeinsamen Singen mit Instrumenten und magischen Bildern. Das Werk wurde am 8. Juni 1937 von der Oper Frankfurt uraufgeführt.

programme.title: Fabien Caux-Lahalle - Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: Maurice Ravel's Boléro made millions for the composer and his heirs. After the death of Ravel's brother in 1960 unleashed a fierce battle over the music rights, a complex legal dispute unfolded before the piece entered the public domain.

programme.title: National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia, Konstantin Khvatynets And Boris Berezovsky - Rachmaninov And Gershwin: Rhapsodies
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 1, Op. 11
programme.desc: Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz performs Robert Schumann's Piano Sonata No. 1 in F-sharp minor, Op. 11, a passionate work completed in 1835 and secretly dedicated to his beloved Clara Wieck.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan And Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris - Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No. 7 and his 15-minute orchestral piece Wellington’s Victory, Op. 91. The shortest of Beethoven’s nine symphonies, Symphony No. 8 lacks a truly slow movement. Instead it has a second movement, Allegretto scherzando, that features a steady ‘ticking’ rhythm maintained by the woodwinds throughout the movement. This is thought to be an imitation of the Andante movement of Joseph Haydn’s ‘Clock’ Symphony. Jordan’s performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Vadim Repin And Murad Huseynov - Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas
programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange au Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music. Murad, the main actor, will represent one of those characters carried by solitude that can be found in the romantic paintings of Friedrich. The overall atmosphere of the musical program is rather melancholic, tending either towards a certain musical lightness, or, on the contrary, towards drama. The production is a cinematographic accompaniment of the music and its performers.

programme.title: Renaud Capuçon, Gerard Causse, Iddo Bar-Shai And Jean-Jacques Kantorow - Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, in which Capuçon and violist Gérard Caussé appear as the soloists. Capuçon is then joined by pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï for a performance of Mozart’s Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304. The program closes with Dmitri Shostakovich’s Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a, which is a transcription of Shostakovich’s String Quartet No. 8 by Russian conductor Rudolf Barshai, the composer’s close friend. This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 15, 2021.

programme.title: Frans Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus, Siobhan Stagg And Avery Amereau - Strauss' Metamorphosen And Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the awakening of nature to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Andrea Vitello, Ensemble Bios And Naomi Sato - Ueda - Someone Out There is Praying for Peace III
programme.desc: Italian conductor Andrea Vitello leads Ensemble BIOS in a performance of ‘Someone Out There is Praying for Peace (Let Us Not Be the Reason), III’, by contemporary Canadian composer Rita Ueda. This piece is written for strings and shō, a Japanese free-reed mouth organ, played here by Naomi Sato. Ensemble BIOS specializes in 20th and 21st century music. This performance was recorded at Chiesa di San Cristo in Brescia, Italy.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan And Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris - Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony. The customary long introduction is replaced by two powerful chords, followed by the introduction of the main theme by the lower strings. The slow second movement is a Funeral March, followed by a quick Scherzo. The fourth and final movement is dominated by a theme from Beethoven’s ballet music for ‘The Creatures of Prometheus’. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt - Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Glenn Gould - Music in the air
programme.desc: Television plays a crucial role in popularizing classical music. Not only has it preserved precious moments of music making, but it also helps shape the future of music. The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. To commemorate this, renowned film maker Reiner E. Moritz produced the documentary 'Music in the air' to shed light on the history of classical music on television. The film dives into television's archives to demonstrate what the medium has done for the dissemination of music. It features rare footage of Arturo Toscanini conducting the NBC Symphony Orchestra in one of the first televised concerts, and captivating fragments from Leonard Bernstein’s Young People Concerts. Moreover, the film contains excerpts of great performances from the past, including those by Glenn Gould, Herbert von Karajan, Igor Stravinsky, and Pierre Boulez.

programme.title: The Philharmonics - A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky’s tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Jihye Kim, Johan Karlström And Christine Nonbo Andersen - Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program. Under the direction of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, Highlander, and The Chronicles of Narnia. Featured soloists in this concert are Danish soprano Christine Nonbo Andersen, Korean percussionist Jihye Kim, Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Swedish bass Johan Karlström, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2019.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería And José Areán - Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 4, composed between 1899 and 1901, depicts a child's vision of heaven, a theme central to the work's innocent and lyrical character. The symphony is notable for its relatively smaller orchestral forces compared to his other symphonies and its focus on melody and a sense of wonder. The final movement features a soprano solo singing about the joys of heaven, providing a serene and optimistic conclusion.

programme.title: Max Emanuel Cencic, Philippe Jaroussky, Andreas Scholl And Franco Fagioli - Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries. For two centuries, castrati's performances held European audiences spellbound, with successful castrati such as Farinelli ranking among the most influential and highest-earning musicians of those days. Today, roles originally written for castrati are often performed by countertenors. In this documentary, countertenors Max Emanuel Cenčić, Philippe Jaroussky, Andreas Scholl, Franco Fagioli, and Jochen Kowalski discuss Baroque-era operatic entertainment. 'Heavenly Voices' is a film by Gino Pennacchi (writer) and Alessandro Scillitani (director).

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada And Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse - Fauré’s Requiem
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz performs Robert Schumann's Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26, a lively five-movement piano cycle depicting Viennese carnival festivities.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Classica Spotlight

programme.title: Alexandre Tharaud - Beethoven - Last Sonatas, Op. 109, 110 And 111
programme.desc: Beethoven’s last three sonatas – Opus 109, 110 and 111 – explore the intimate meanders of the human soul, from despair to transfiguration. At the time of their composition, Beethoven was already locked in himself by his deafness. This deeply affected his relationship to others and to the world. This psychological framework is explored by director Mariano Nante, setting pianist Alexandre Tharaud in a film inspired by the universe of Tarkovski. Filmed in abandoned castles, and lit by director of photography Yorgos Arvanitis, this work evokes solitude and introspection and offers an inner journey through images and music.
